app.title: Lendermarket AI Assistant
app.subtitle: Investor information
welcome.message: Hello! I'm the Lendermarket AI Assistant. How can I help you today?
input.hint: Press Enter to send, Shift + Enter for a new line
chat.clearConfirm: Clear this conversation? This cannot be undone.
chat.typing: The assistant is preparing an answer…
sources.title: Sources
notice.disclaimer: This AI assistant provides general information only and does not offer personalized financial advice.
notice.privacy: Please do not share passwords, verification codes, banking details or identity documents in this chat. Conversations are not stored and are cleared when you close this page.
notice.accountSpecific: For questions about your own account, please contact Lendermarket Support through a verified channel.
notice.redacted: For your security, some personal details were removed from your message before it was processed.
answer.insufficient: I'm sorry, but I couldn't find verified information about this in the available Lendermarket resources. Would you like to contact our support team?
answer.conflict: The available sources contain differing information on this topic, so it requires confirmation from Lendermarket Support.
escalation.prompt: Would you like to contact Lendermarket Support?
escalation.notConfigured: Support contact details are not available yet. Please visit the official Lendermarket website.
escalation.requestInfo: Your chat history will not be sent. Only the topic you choose is included. Please do not include passwords, verification codes or identity documents in your request.
errors.database: We're experiencing a temporary technical issue. Please try again later.
errors.aiUnavailable: The assistant is temporarily unavailable. Please try again or contact support.
errors.rateLimit: Too many requests. Please try again later.
errors.tooLong: Your message is too long. Please shorten it to {max} characters or fewer.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.invalid: Your message could not be processed. Please rephrase it.
errors.offline: You appear to be offline. Please check your connection.
feedback.question: Was this helpful?
